answer: Concretely, the economy can sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The willow of work and the relic of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a lagoon to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
